text: {"criteria":{"task":{"band":6.0,"summary":"文章回应了题目两个部分（公共交通与新建道路），立场是“主要支持公共交通、必要时也修路”的有限立场，并在结论中保持一致。主要观点有原因或例子支撑，但论证较浅，多为泛泛而谈，且部分表达（如“in some way but not all”）略显含糊。","strengths":[{"quote":"I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.","comment":"开篇即表明有限立场，为后文兼顾两方面做了铺垫。"},{"quote":"In conclusion, I think goverment should spend more money for public transport but also build some road when it is necessary.","comment":"结论清晰重申了“以公共交通为主、必要时修路”的立场，与正文一致。"},{"quote":"For example my father drive to work everyday and he spend two hour in the road.","comment":"用个人例子支撑“需要新路”的观点，具体可感。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.","comment":"立场表述含糊，“in some way but not all”没有说明在哪些方面同意，读者需读完全文才能推断。","suggestion":"开头就点明倾向，例如：I largely agree that governments should prioritise public transport, although new roads are still needed in some cases."},{"quote":"Also if more people take bus, the city will be more quiet and the air will be more clean, so everybody can be more healthy and happy.","comment":"论证停留在断言层面，缺少机制说明，且“more quiet and happy”略显夸张，削弱说服力。","suggestion":"补充因果链，例如：fewer cars means less exhaust and noise, which lowers respiratory illness and improves residents' quality of life."}]},"coherence":{"band":5.5,"summary":"文章分段清晰，每段有明确主题，并使用Firstly、Secondly、But等连接词推进。但连接手段较为机械、单一，部分指代和逻辑衔接不够自然，段落内部句子间的衔接有时靠简单并列堆叠。","strengths":[{"quote":"Firstly, public transport is good for people.","comment":"用序数词明确标示论证顺序，结构清楚。"},{"quote":"But I think public transport is more important than road.","comment":"用转折词引出作者的核心倾向，段落间过渡明确。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"Secondly, new road is also important.","comment":"连接词使用机械，且“Secondly”与前段“Firstly”并列，但两段实际是正反两面，逻辑关系未体现。","suggestion":"改用体现让步关系的连接，例如：However, building new roads also matters, because..."},{"quote":"This is very bad for him and for the economy also.","comment":"句末“also”位置生硬，句间衔接靠简单附加，缺乏自然的指代或过渡。","suggestion":"改为：This wastes both his time and the economy's resources, which shows why some new roads are still necessary."}]},"lexical":{"band":5.0,"summary":"词汇量有限，多为高频基础词，能传达基本意思，但拼写错误较多（goverment、enviroment、crowd等），搭配和词形也有问题（more better、more fast、the city is grow）。较少使用不常见词汇或地道搭配。","strengths":[{"quote":"The public transport can carry many people in one time","comment":"能围绕主题使用相关词汇表达基本意思。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"goverment should spend money for public transport not for build new road","comment":"拼写错误（goverment应为government），且“for build”词形错误，介词搭配不当。","suggestion":"改为：the government should spend money on public transport rather than on building new roads."},{"quote":"If the bus is more better","comment":"双重比较级错误，“more better”不合法。","suggestion":"改为：If the bus service were better,"},{"quote":"the bus is always late and very crowd","comment":"“crowd”为名词/动词，此处应为形容词crowded，词形错误。","suggestion":"改为：the buses are always late and very crowded."},{"quote":"it is good for enviroment","comment":"拼写错误，应为environment。","suggestion":"改为：it is good for the environment."}]},"grammar":{"band":5.0,"summary":"能使用一些简单句和少量复合句（if条件句、because从句），但语法错误频繁，包括主谓一致、冠词、比较级、词形和时态问题，影响准确性。错误虽多但基本不影响理解。","strengths":[{"quote":"If there is no new road the traffic jam will be very bad","comment":"能正确使用if条件句表达因果，结构基本完整。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"Because many people dont have car","comment":"缺少冠词（a car），且dont缺撇号。","suggestion":"改为：Because many people do not have a car"},{"quote":"the city is grow","comment":"be动词后误用动词原形，应为进行时或形容词。","suggestion":"改为：the city is growing"},{"quote":"he spend two hour in the road","comment":"主谓不一致（he spend），且可数名词单复数错误（two hour）。","suggestion":"改为：he spends two hours on the road"},{"quote":"Both is important for the people and the country develop","comment":"主谓不一致（Both is），且“the country develop”结构错误。","suggestion":"改为：Both are important for the people and for the country's development."}]}},"argument":{"position":{"quote":"I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.","consistent":true,"comment":"作者持有限立场：主要支持投资公共交通，但认为必要时仍需修路，全文与结论一致，未出现自相矛盾。"},"paragraphs":[{"p":1,"role":"introduction","main_point":"I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.","verdict":"supports","comment":"引出话题并表明有限立场，虽略含糊但方向明确。"},{"p":2,"role":"body","main_point":"Firstly, public transport is good for people.","verdict":"supports","comment":"用无车人群需求、公交改善可减少交通等理由支撑公共交通的重要性，并有本地例子。"},{"p":3,"role":"body","main_point":"Secondly, new road is also important.","verdict":"supports","comment":"论证新建道路的必要性，用城市扩张、父亲通勤的例子支撑，服务于有限立场。"},{"p":4,"role":"body","main_point":"But I think public transport is more important than road.","verdict":"supports","comment":"说明公共交通优于道路的理由（减少污染、载客量大），强化主要倾向。"},{"p":5,"role":"conclusion","main_point":"In conclusion, I think goverment should spend more money for public transport but also build some road when it is necessary.","verdict":"supports","comment":"结论重申有限立场，与正文一致。"}],"problems":[],"improvements":[{"quote":"In my city the bus is always late and very crowd so people dont like to take it.","suggestion":"可进一步说明改善公交后如何具体减少私家车使用，使论证更有层次。"},{"quote":"This is very bad for him and for the economy also.","suggestion":"可补充一句解释为何个人通勤时间浪费会影响经济，使例子与观点联系更紧密。"}]},"overall_comment":"这是一篇结构完整、立场基本清晰的作文，能兼顾公共交通与新建道路两方面，并给出理由和例子。主要短板在语言：拼写、词形、主谓一致和比较级错误较多，词汇偏基础，连接词使用较机械。论证虽成立但较浅，部分观点停留在断言层面。建议优先提升语法准确性和基础拼写，同时让开头立场更明确、论证更有因果深度。","priorities":["修正高频语法错误：主谓一致（he spend、Both is）、比较级（more better、more fast）、词形（is grow、crowd）","纠正拼写：government、environment、crowded等，并注意冠词（a car）","开头明确立场，说明在哪些方面同意，避免“in some way but not all”这类含糊表述","丰富连接手段，用让步、因果等逻辑关系替代机械的Firstly/Secondly","为主要观点补充因果机制或更具体的例子，提升论证深度"]}

{"criteria":{"task":{"band":6.5,"summary":"全文回应了题目两个层面：支持优先发展公共交通，同时承认部分地区仍需修路，立场清晰且贯穿全文。两个支持理由（运力效率、环境）都有因果解释和例子，让步段也点明了农村与货运的现实需求。不足之处在于论证深度有限，例子较简略，未充分展开为何预算应优先给公交而非道路。","strengths":[{"quote":"If buses and trains are frequent, cheap and reliable, many drivers will choose them, which will reduce traffic jams.","comment":"用条件句清楚交代了机制：公交条件改善→私家车减少→拥堵缓解，论证链条完整。"},{"quote":"For example, after my city opened a new metro line, the main road to the city centre became much less crowded during rush hour.","comment":"个人化例子紧接论点，直接支撑“公交能缓解拥堵”，衔接自然。"},{"quote":"However, they should still build roads in places where public transport is not practical.","comment":"结论重申了限定条件，与开头“some road building is still necessary”保持一致，立场前后统一。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"Public transport produces less pollution per passenger, so it is a more sustainable option in the long term.","comment":"环境段只有一句因果断言，缺少具体展开（如减少多少排放、如何影响健康），论证略显单薄。","suggestion":"可补充一句机制或假设例子，如 'For instance, if a commuter switches from a private car to a bus, the carbon emissions per person can fall sharply.'"},{"quote":"Also, goods are mostly transported by trucks, and poor roads can slow down the economy.","comment":"让步段两个理由都点到即止，未说明为何这构成“仍需修路”的充分理由。","suggestion":"可加一句因果说明，如 'This means that in these areas road investment is not a luxury but a basic condition for economic activity.'"}]},"coherence":{"band":6.5,"summary":"文章分段清晰，五段结构（引入—理由一—理由二—让步—结论）逻辑顺畅，衔接词使用自然（The main reason, Another advantage, On the other hand, In conclusion）。指代和主题句基本到位。但段内句子之间的连接有时较简单，部分衔接依赖并列连词，段落内部展开的层次感可以更强。","strengths":[{"quote":"The main reason to invest in public transport is that it can move a large number of people efficiently.","comment":"主题句明确，直接点出本段核心，读者易于把握段落功能。"},{"quote":"On the other hand, new roads are sometimes needed.","comment":"用对比衔接词自然转入让步段，段落间过渡清晰。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"Another advantage is the environment.","comment":"主题句过于简短，未说明“环境”具体指哪方面的优势，段落方向略显模糊。","suggestion":"可改为 'Another advantage is environmental: public transport produces far less pollution per passenger than private cars.'"},{"quote":"Cars produce a lot of air pollution and carbon emissions, which are harmful to people's health and contribute to climate change.","comment":"段内句子多为并列陈述，缺少进一步递进或举例来深化层次。","suggestion":"可加入递进连接，如 'As a result, ...' 或 'This is especially important in dense cities where ...' 使论证更有层次。"}]},"lexical":{"band":6.5,"summary":"词汇足以表达观点，使用了一些恰当搭配（traffic congestion, carbon emissions, sustainable option, give priority to）。但整体词汇偏常见，较少出现非常见或精准的表达，个别地方用词较笼统（如 'a lot of'）。拼写与构词基本无误。","strengths":[{"quote":"traffic congestion has become a serious problem","comment":"'traffic congestion' 是地道搭配，用词准确。"},{"quote":"it is a more sustainable option in the long term","comment":"'sustainable option' 与 'in the long term' 搭配自然，体现一定词汇水平。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"Cars produce a lot of air pollution and carbon emissions","comment":"'a lot of' 偏口语化，正式写作中可换用更精确的表达。","suggestion":"可改为 'Cars generate substantial air pollution and carbon emissions'。"},{"quote":"poor roads can slow down the economy","comment":"'slow down the economy' 表达可理解但略笼统，可更具体。","suggestion":"可改为 'poor road conditions can hamper economic activity and raise transport costs'。"}]},"grammar":{"band":6.5,"summary":"句式有一定变化，使用了条件句、定语从句和并列结构，多数句子语法正确、可读性强。但复杂句比例有限，部分句子结构较简单，个别地方（如 'which are harmful'）指代稍显松散。整体错误很少，属较稳的6.5水平。","strengths":[{"quote":"If buses and trains are frequent, cheap and reliable, many drivers will choose them, which will reduce traffic jams.","comment":"条件句加非限制性定语从句，结构完整，语法准确。"},{"quote":"A single train can carry hundreds of passengers, while the same number of people would need hundreds of cars.","comment":"用 while 构成对比，句式平衡，表达清晰。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"which are harmful to people's health and contribute to climate change","comment":"which 指代前面两个并列名词（pollution 和 emissions），指代略显模糊。","suggestion":"可明确指代，如 'both of which are harmful to people's health and contribute to climate change'。"},{"quote":"In rural areas, there are not enough passengers to make train lines profitable, so people depend on cars.","comment":"句子正确但结构较简单，复杂句运用可更丰富。","suggestion":"可尝试更复杂的结构，如 'In rural areas, where passenger numbers are too low for train lines to be profitable, people have little choice but to rely on cars.'"}]}},"argument":{"position":{"quote":"I mostly agree with this view, although I believe some road building is still necessary.","consistent":true,"comment":"立场为“基本同意优先发展公交，但部分地区仍需修路”，属于有保留的同意，全文与结论均保持一致。"},"paragraphs":[{"p":1,"role":"introduction","main_point":"I mostly agree with this view, although I believe some road building is still necessary.","verdict":"supports","comment":"引入背景并明确给出有保留的立场，为下文定调。"},{"p":2,"role":"body","main_point":"The main reason to invest in public transport is that it can move a large number of people efficiently.","verdict":"supports","comment":"用运力对比、条件机制和个人例子支撑公交优先，论证充分。"},{"p":3,"role":"body","main_point":"Another advantage is the environment.","verdict":"supports","comment":"从环境角度支持公交优先，有因果解释，但展开较简略。"},{"p":4,"role":"concession","main_point":"On the other hand, new roads are sometimes needed.","verdict":"supports","comment":"让步段说明农村与货运仍需道路，界定了立场范围，与结论呼应，未削弱主论点。"},{"p":5,"role":"conclusion","main_point":"In conclusion, I agree that governments should give priority to public transport because it is more efficient and better for the environment.","verdict":"supports","comment":"结论重申主立场并保留修路的例外，与开头一致。"}],"problems":[],"improvements":[{"quote":"Public transport produces less pollution per passenger, so it is a more sustainable option in the long term.","suggestion":"可补充一个假设例子或机制说明，使环境论点更有说服力。"},{"quote":"On the other hand, new roads are sometimes needed.","suggestion":"可加一句说明为何这些情况不改变“公交优先”的总原则，使让步与主论点衔接更紧。"}]},"overall_comment":"这是一篇结构清晰、立场明确、语言基本准确的作文，约6.5分水平。优点是五段式结构完整，有保留的立场贯穿全文，理由有因果解释和例子支撑，语法错误很少。主要提升空间在于论证深度：环境段和让步段展开较简略，词汇偏常见，复杂句式比例可再提高。若能在每个论点后补充更具体的机制或例子，并丰富词汇与句式，有望达到7分。","priorities":["深化每个论点的论证：在断言后补充机制说明或具体（可为假设的）例子，尤其是环境段和让步段。","提升词汇精确度与多样性：用 generate substantial pollution、hamper economic activity 等替换 a lot of、slow down 等笼统表达。","增加复杂句式比例：多用定语从句、条件句、让步状语从句，并注意 which 等指代明确。","强化段内衔接：用 As a result、This is especially important 等递进连接，使段落层次更分明。"]}

{"criteria":{"task":{"band":7.5,"summary":"全文完整回应题目，立场明确且有保留（大部分资金投向公共交通，但必要时仍需修路），并在引言、让步段和结论中保持一致。每个主体段都有因果或机制性论证支撑，如车道容量有限、新路诱发更多驾驶、公交惠及无车人群并减排。论证充分但例子多为概括性说明，缺少具体展开，因此未达更高档。","strengths":[{"quote":"it addresses the causes of traffic problems rather than merely their symptoms","comment":"引言即点明核心立场并给出理由，立场清晰、有保留。"},{"quote":"a lane of motorway can carry only a fixed number of private vehicles per hour, whereas a well-run rail or bus rapid transit line can move many times that number of people","comment":"用容量对比支撑效率论点，论证具体有力。"},{"quote":"Targeted road improvements, such as bypasses around congested towns, can therefore remain a sensible use of funds.","comment":"让步段限定了立场范围，与结论一致，未削弱主论点。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"there is considerable evidence that new roads tend to fill up quickly","comment":"提及“大量证据”却未给出任何具体来源或机制细节，略显空泛。","suggestion":"可补一句机制说明，如 'because extra capacity lowers journey times and attracts drivers who previously used other routes'，使论证更扎实。"}]},"coherence":{"band":7.5,"summary":"文章结构清晰：引言—两个支持段—让步段—结论，逻辑推进自然。段落主题句明确，衔接词使用得当且不过度（Moreover, therefore, Nevertheless, At the same time）。指代与段落间过渡顺畅，但个别衔接略显程式化，尚未达到更高档的灵活多样。","strengths":[{"quote":"The strongest argument for prioritising public transport is efficiency.","comment":"主题句直接点明段落核心，读者易于跟随。"},{"quote":"Expanding road networks may therefore offer only temporary relief before congestion returns.","comment":"用 therefore 收束因果链，衔接自然。"},{"quote":"Nevertheless, it would be unrealistic to stop road building altogether.","comment":"转折词清晰引出让步段，段落功能明确。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"At the same time, shifting journeys from cars to trains and buses reduces both air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions","comment":"同一段内并列两个论点，衔接词 At the same time 略显机械，且社会效益与环境效益的转换稍显突兀。","suggestion":"可改为 'Beyond access, public transport also delivers environmental gains: shifting journeys...'，使两个论点层次更分明。"}]},"lexical":{"band":7.5,"summary":"词汇资源较丰富，能使用较不常见且准确的表达，如 'inherently limited resource'、'bus rapid transit line'、'affordable mobility'、'sparsely populated regions'，搭配自然。拼写与词形基本无误。个别表达稍显套语化，未达更高档的精准与多样。","strengths":[{"quote":"Roads are an inherently limited resource","comment":"用词精准，抽象概念表达到位。"},{"quote":"It gives affordable mobility to those who cannot drive","comment":"搭配自然，语义清晰。"},{"quote":"In sparsely populated regions, buses and trains are rarely viable","comment":"较不常见词汇使用准确，语域恰当。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"delivering social and environmental gains","comment":"gains 与 deliver 搭配可用，但略显笼统，与前文 benefits 语义重复。","suggestion":"可改为 'while also easing pressure on the environment and widening access to opportunity'，使表达更具体。"}]},"grammar":{"band":7.5,"summary":"句式多样，能熟练使用定语从句、让步状语从句、比较结构和分词短语，多数句子无错误。标点使用规范。偶有句子较长导致信息密集，但未影响理解，整体语法准确度较高。","strengths":[{"quote":"whereas a well-run rail or bus rapid transit line can move many times that number of people in the same space","comment":"比较结构使用准确，句子平衡。"},{"quote":"which is increasingly important as cities attempt to meet climate targets","comment":"非限制性定语从句与时间状语从句嵌套自然。"},{"quote":"although some road investment is still justified, governments should concentrate their spending on public transport","comment":"让步状语从句使用规范，主句清晰。"}],"issues":[{"quote":"as cheaper and faster journeys encourage more people to drive","comment":"该从句与前文 'new roads tend to fill up quickly' 之间的因果逻辑靠 as 连接，但句子较长，读者需回读才能理清关系。","suggestion":"可拆分为两句：'New roads tend to fill up quickly. Cheaper and faster journeys simply encourage more people to drive.'"}]}},"argument":{"position":{"quote":"I largely agree that public transport deserves the greater share of investment, because it addresses the causes of traffic problems rather than merely their symptoms.","consistent":true,"comment":"立场明确且有保留，全文围绕“大部分资金投向公交、必要时修路”展开，结论与之一致。"},"paragraphs":[{"p":1,"role":"introduction","main_point":"I largely agree that public transport deserves the greater
